name: Usuario
description: UPN of the human on whose behalf the agent acts

name: Agente
description: Agent identity (Entra Agent ID app ID or name)

name: Cliente
description: MCP client or host (VS Code, Copilot Studio, custom app)

name: Servidor
description: MCP server name as registered in the internal registry

name: Operacion
description: JSON-RPC method, for example tools/list or tools/call

name: HuellaDefiniciones
description: SHA-256 of the canonical tool definitions returned by tools/list

name: ArgumentosRedactados
description: Tool arguments with secrets and personal data redacted

name: DestinosEnArgumentos
description: External hosts or email domains found in the arguments
